perKindVerbCoverage.definition: stored relationship rows per canonical kind, on the pinned symbols, counted as rendered only when the card emitted a link whose (file, line) equals an index-stored location for that row's far end AND the link sits under the declared verb for that kind and direction. A non-declaration row under a containment word is counted as `mislabelled`, never as covered.
perKindVerbCoverage.replaces: the earlier metric, which scored kinds by grepping the rendered card for English words. That awarded `references` a score on seven cards because the usages header reads 'N stored references', and scored `contains` ZERO because it had no prose word. Kept beside this one as `namedKinds` so the gap between them stays visible.

perKind.declaredReason: an `imports` row is a FILE-level edge: its far end is a module path, not an indexed symbol, so it has no index-stored location to navigate to. It is counted and named as a file-level row, never rendered as a symbol link (§13.5 noise is labelled, not hidden; §12.1 nothing unclickable).

perKindVerbCoverage.kindsNotStoredNote: These canonical kinds store no row on the pinned symbols of this fixture, so their denominator is ZERO. They are neither passing nor failing: an unstored row cannot be rendered or missing. Their verbs are still gated by V1a, which asserts the table is total over all ten regardless of whether the fixture exercises it.

declaredAbsence.reason: a stored row whose far end is an external name the index holds no symbol row for cannot be rendered as a link: §12.1 requires every target to equal an index-stored location, and this row stores none. The count is reported, the row is not named as a link.
a self-loop row (both ends are this symbol) is an analyzer artifact, not a relationship to another symbol; rendering it would make a symbol appear to relate to itself.
a stored kind outside the canonical ten has no declared verb and no declared meaning; it renders nothing rather than being guessed at. The count is reported.

an `imports` row is a FILE-level edge: its far end is a module path, not an indexed symbol, so it has no index-stored location to navigate to. It is counted and named as a file-level row, never rendered as a symbol link (§13.5 noise is labelled, not hidden; §12.1 nothing unclickable).

budget.note: Measured on a seeded fixture of the same SHAPE as a real busy symbol (one function with stored call rows across many files), not on a corpus census. The per-call location memo in src/lsp/rich_hover.ts is what this number is a verdict on: before it, the collector resolved one location per ROW, re-reading and re-mapping a file per row.

limitations: The fixture is a REAL seeded index (real schema, real files on disk, real hashes) but it is AUTHORED, not a corpus census: the ratio it reports is the ratio this fixture's shape produces, not a corpus-wide rate.
The ratios are measured against the pinned symbols only; a symbol with no stored rows renders nothing, which is declared absence and is not counted as a gap.

The per-kind metric's denominator is the stored rows of the 9 PINNED symbols, not a corpus census: 29 rows in total. It says nothing about kinds this fixture does not store (extends, implements, overrides, imports, exports), which are declared rather than scored because their denominator is zero.

The per-kind metric attributes a rendered row to a stored row by matching the link's target against the index-stored location of that row's far end. Where two stored rows share one far-end location (two kinds to the same symbol on the same line) the attribution is to the link, and both rows are credited only if a link under each kind's own verb exists — a card that rendered one of them once would score the other as a gap. That is deliberate: it is what made the collector's location dedup visible.
The call-site differential classifies stored lines through src/intelligence/graph/line-address.ts, which is the declared owner; it does not re-derive the rule.
No editor leg: every measurement here is the server component over the wire-less path. The editor render of these same facts is §12.6 E5 scope.

the warm p95 measured here is 21.13 ms against the declared 50 ms budget, inside it on this machine at this load; the figure is a percentile of 200 timed requests on an AUTHORED fixture, not a corpus rate, and a loaded machine moves it (this lane measured 88.05 ms under load average 12+).
